item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-b4df433f50dd2f2a","start_unit":7,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"The German government launched a €500 billion Special Fund for Infrastructure and Climate Neutrality in 2025, established through a Basic Law amendment and allocated across federal, Länder/local, and climate-transformation investments; a monitoring system was created.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.3","5B.6","6B.9","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"Outside the requested 2023-2023 period; not attributable to Scholz's 2023 record.","ruler_attribution":"No direct Olaf Scholz attribution; the source concerns a later German government.","limitations":["The document is about 2025 onward, not 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-76a0ddf17979b545","start_unit":4,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"Germany's Recovery and Resilience Plan was approved in 2021 and updated in 2024; the plan comprises €32.3 billion in total value, 28 investments and 17 reforms, with 49.5% supporting climate objectives and 47.5% supporting digital transition.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","8B.1","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The plan was active during 2023, but the source page incorporates later updates and does not isolate 2023 implementation.","ruler_attribution":"The plan was implemented by the German federal government during Scholz's chancellorship, but the source does not assign personal responsibility to Scholz.","limitations":["Later revisions are included; the source does not provide a 2023-only execution result."]},{"source_id":"SRC-76a0ddf17979b545","start_unit":7,"end_unit":10,"fact_summary":"Germany's plan includes measures for renewable hydrogen, greener transport, residential energy renovation, digital public services, registers, education, childcare, apprenticeships, hospital digitalisation, public-health offices, and reforms intended to unlock public investment; the page identifies €3.7 billion for economic decarbonisation, €7 billion for greener transport, €6.2 billion for residential renovation, €2.5 billion for digital public services, €500 million for 90,000 childcare places, €3 billion for hospital digitalisation, and €684 million for public-health offices.","question_ids":["5B.6","6B.2","6B.3","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Measures and commitments were part of the plan in force during 2023, but the page includes subsequent modifications and projected rather than fully realized outcomes.","ruler_attribution":"The measures were adopted by the German government and EU institutions; no personal Scholz attribution is stated.","limitations":["Most figures are planned allocations or targets, not verified 2023 outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-9b5d654dce10d57c","start_unit":4,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"The Federal Court of Auditors reported that the federal budget was strongly expansionary from 2020 to 2024, causing federal debt to grow substantially while rising interest costs reduced fiscal room for infrastructure, digitalisation, defence, and climate protection.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.9","5B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Includes 2023 within a broader 2020-2024 assessment; it does not isolate Scholz's individual decisions.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns federal budget policy during the Scholz government period, but attributes no personal act to Scholz.","limitations":["The finding covers multiple years and governments."]},{"source_id":"SRC-9b5d654dce10d57c","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"The Federal Court of Auditors found that Germany lost €52 million in Brexit Adjustment Reserve funding because responsible authorities failed to steer and control implementation adequately; Germany applied for only about €375 million of €427 million remaining in September 2024.","question_ids":["5B.7","8B.5","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The finding was published in 2024 and concerns implementation extending beyond 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns federal administrative responsibility, especially the BMWK, not a personal decision by Scholz.","limitations":["The source does not establish Scholz's personal involvement."]},{"source_id":"SRC-9b5d654dce10d57c","start_unit":6,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"The Federal Court of Auditors found that nearly 65,000 self-employed people received Bürgergeld, about one-third for at least five years; in 82% of reviewed cases, job centres had not assessed whether self-employment was viable, and the BMAS had not acted despite similar 2017 warnings.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.5","6B.7","8B.8"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Published in 2024; the underlying administrative problems include the 2023 period.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns BMAS and job-centre administration during Scholz's government, without personal attribution to Scholz.","limitations":["The audit covers selected job centres and does not prove personal knowledge or direction by Scholz."]},{"source_id":"SRC-9b5d654dce10d57c","start_unit":7,"end_unit":10,"fact_summary":"The Federal Court of Auditors identified several federal implementation and oversight failures: the BMDV lacked an owner strategy for Deutsche Bahn after more than 30 years; a €87.5 million 2023 long-distance rail subsidy was launched without the required prior economic assessment and later judged uneconomic; and the BMDV failed to review more than 100 above-tariff Autobahn GmbH contracts, including appointments from networks without adequate public advertising or documented selection decisions.","question_ids":["5B.5","5B.6","5B.7","8B.2","8B.4","8B.5","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The rail subsidy and contract findings directly include 2023; the Deutsche Bahn finding spans 1994-2024.","ruler_attribution":"The findings concern BMDV and affiliated entities, not a personally documented act by Scholz.","limitations":["The source does not establish that Scholz personally directed these decisions."]},{"source_id":"SRC-9b5d654dce10d57c","start_unit":10,"end_unit":11,"fact_summary":"The Federal Court of Auditors found that the Foreign Office lacked a complete overview of Germany's international-organisation contributions: €8.7 billion was paid in 2022, but €1.9 billion was not captured in its recorded UN-only total; it also found year-end payment spikes in development assistance that impaired budget transparency.","question_ids":["5B.7","7B.6","8B.5"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The quantitative contribution finding concerns 2022 and the audit was published in 2024; it is contextual rather than a 2023-specific result.","ruler_attribution":"The findings concern federal ministries and administrative systems, not a personal Scholz action.","limitations":["No direct personal attribution to Scholz."]},{"source_id":"SRC-9b5d654dce10d57c","start_unit":11,"end_unit":11,"fact_summary":"The Federal Court of Auditors reported that 90% of examined cases involving a tax reduction for overlapping inheritance and income taxation applied the rule incorrectly, and criticized a planned delay of a related administrative reform until 2030 despite available data.","question_ids":["5B.7","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Published in 2024; the reform dispute spans the Scholz government's period.","ruler_attribution":"The findings concern the BMF and tax administration, without personal attribution to Scholz.","limitations":["The audit does not establish Scholz's personal role."]},{"source_id":"SRC-41e62f43ef3d65b4","start_unit":24,"end_unit":24,"fact_summary":"At a June 2023 Bundestag hearing, most legal experts criticized the Union's proposed second Cum-Ex investigation committee as wholly or largely unconstitutional because it targeted Hamburg state conduct beyond the Bundestag's ordinary oversight; other experts considered the application constitutional if focused on federal supervision and tax-recovery matters, including Scholz's conduct as chancellor.","question_ids":["4B.4","7B.6","7B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The evidence concerns legal scrutiny of the proposed investigation into matters associated with Scholz, but records expert disagreement rather than a final finding against him.","limitations":["This is a hearing about the legality and scope of an investigative proposal, not a final adjudication of Scholz's conduct."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a43f97468741f2cd","start_unit":23,"end_unit":25,"fact_summary":"In October 2023 the federal cabinet adopted a special report on bureaucracy reduction covering completed, ongoing, and planned measures; since January 2023 new draft laws had undergone a digital implementation check, and the government reported a projected minimum €2.3 billion in relief from the planned BEG IV and Growth Opportunities Act measures after a consultation that received 442 proposals from more than 57 associations.","question_ids":["5B.4","5B.6","5B.7","8B.1","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023, though the €2.3 billion figure was projected rather than realized.","ruler_attribution":"A cabinet-level initiative during Scholz's chancellorship; the source attributes it institutionally to the federal government, not personally to Scholz.","limitations":["The reported relief was a forecast and BEG IV was still being drafted."]},{"source_id":"SRC-ea8c01e06c8f49fb","start_unit":6,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"In a May 2023 speech, Scholz stated that Germany had secured energy supplies through the prior winter and avoided a broad, long-term economic crisis, while setting or reaffirming goals of climate neutrality by 2045, 80% renewable electricity by 2030, faster grid and hydrogen-network construction, and expanded electricity production.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","5B.9","8B.1","8B.2","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz personally made these claims and announced or endorsed these goals in his capacity as chancellor.","limitations":["The energy-security claim is a self-assessment in a political speech; the future targets were not yet outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-ea8c01e06c8f49fb","start_unit":8,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"Scholz argued in May 2023 that Germany needed to shorten approval times and simplify legal requirements because existing procedures would prevent the country from meeting renewable-energy, electricity-production, and hydrogen-production targets; he also supported hydrogen-ready gas plants and semiconductor investment.","question_ids":["5B.4","5B.6","8B.1","8B.2","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz personally articulated the diagnosis and proposed administrative and infrastructure responses.","limitations":["The speech records stated intentions and diagnoses, not completed implementation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b587925d04598b10","start_unit":6,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"In June 2023 the federal government announced participation in the Ukraine Reconstruction Conference, supported grants and concessional loans for war-affected Ukrainian small and medium-sized businesses, and linked reconstruction support to administrative reform, transparency, decentralisation, demining, investment guarantees, and EU-accession reforms.","question_ids":["2B.1","2B.7","2B.10","5B.6","8B.2","8B.6","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The measures were announced by federal ministries under Scholz's government; the source does not record a personal Scholz decision.","limitations":["The document describes government policy and implementation plans, not verified long-term outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b587925d04598b10","start_unit":7,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"In June 2023 the federal government stated that Israeli settlements were illegal under international law and endangered a two-state solution, expressed concern about civilian and minor deaths in Jenin, emphasized proportionality, and supported continuation of regional dialogue processes.","question_ids":["2B.1","2B.3","2B.7","3B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The position was stated by the Foreign Office on behalf of the federal government during Scholz's chancellorship, not personally by Scholz.","limitations":["The statement records diplomatic policy and rhetoric, not enforcement or measurable conflict outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b587925d04598b10","start_unit":9,"end_unit":10,"fact_summary":"In June 2023 the German government said security authorities continued monitoring Chinese overseas police stations in Germany and would not tolerate such activities; it also demanded Alexei Navalny's immediate release and described his detention as based on a politically motivated judgment, while acknowledging that channels for obtaining information from Russia were very limited.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.4","3B.8","2B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The positions were stated by federal government and Foreign Office officials during Scholz's chancellorship; no personal Scholz action is documented.","limitations":["Monitoring and diplomatic demands are reported, but the source does not show their concrete effect."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-b04a653bcc27b7c0","SRC-8d2bb0e15cb38f26","SRC-476682dba188ad5e","SRC-da53a4c864c93a04","SRC-2141d597e4e5a639"],"batch_limitations":["Several supplied pages are generic navigation pages, later-period materials, or policy descriptions without 2023 outcome evidence.","The supplied documents provide limited direct evidence about Scholz's personal conduct; many facts concern federal institutions or cabinet policy during his chancellorship.","No score is assigned."]}
